query: /* select#1 */ select (case when (`o`.`status` = 'zq-paid-8842') then 'zq-done-1193' else 'zq-open-2284' end) AS `CASE WHEN o.status = 'zq-paid-8842' THEN 'zq-done-1193' ELSE 'zq-open-2284' END`,ifnull(`c`.`name`,'zq-anon-3375') AS `IFNULL(c.name, 'zq-anon-3375')` from `shop`.`orders` `o` join `shop`.`customers` `c` where (`o`.`customer_id` = `c`.`id`)

inputs.operation: Index lookup on o using idx_customer (customer_id=c.id)
